requirements.title: Shared web shells and complete page-template contracts
requirements.summary: Deliver the public and authenticated web shells through shared presentation templates, including explicit doctor/practice/location context, navigation and reliable interaction states. Acceptance: All new visual composition is exported from packages/ui; product queries remain in Doctor Suit adapters. The active doctor/practice/location is persistently clear; switching context clears sensitive caches and drafts. Navigation, keyboard/focus, dirty-state warnings, loading/empty/error/denied states work from the first slice. English/Arabic, LTR/RTL and light/dark use existing repository infrastructure if the monorepo decision is approved.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-004.

requirements.title: Public product website and truthful feature presentation
requirements.summary: Build the Doctor Suit public homepage and product explanation around the doctor-across-clinics model using the shared landing template. Acceptance: Explain doctor ownership, location independence, delegated staff and future patient/mobile continuity using approved content. Separate implemented, preview and planned capabilities; no fabricated customers, reviews, compliance badges or release history. Do not invent pricing, trial length, payment availability, download links or production onboarding. Primary actions go to a real approved route; use a preview/explanation state rather than fake submission or account creation.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-005.

requirements.title: Doctor authentication and account recovery
requirements.summary: Implement the doctor web identity lifecycle using existing shared auth templates and product-isolated session adapters, with no cross-product SSO by implication. Acceptance: Support sign-up/sign-in/sign-out, verification and recovery states with explicit provider configuration gates. Do not infer a verified identity or ownership from matching email/phone or editable metadata. Validate redirects/callbacks and preserve product/environment cookie isolation. Expiry, retries, refresh and errors cannot leave an authenticated-looking but unauthorized session.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-006.

requirements.title: Doctor-led practice onboarding and profile
requirements.summary: Let an authenticated doctor create and maintain a practice profile and reach a usable workspace without employing a secretary. The doctor is the future subscriber; no paid entitlement is fabricated. Acceptance: A doctor can complete onboarding alone and add an initial location. Onboarding is resumable and idempotent; double-submit does not create duplicate practices. Store only the approved profile fields; professional verification is not asserted unless independently established. Show incomplete configuration honestly; later subscription rules do not block a synthetic preview.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-007.

requirements.title: Multiple clinic locations and practice context switching
requirements.summary: Let a doctor manage multiple working locations without making a location the owner of their practice records. Acceptance: Create/edit/archive locations and configure contact/schedule context without deleting linked history. A doctor retains practice-level patients while encounters/appointments retain location attribution. Location visibility honors membership grants; no inference from a client-selected location ID. Use an explicit configurable timezone; do not hardcode fixed UTC offsets.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-008.

requirements.title: Secretary invitations and multi-doctor memberships
requirements.summary: Enable invited secretaries to use one Doctor Suit identity across independent doctor memberships without becoming subscribers or mixing practices. Acceptance: Invitation acceptance validates intended recipient, expiry, membership scope and idempotency. The same secretary can belong to two practices with different location grants. Revocation/suspension invalidates protected access according to tested session/cache guarantees. No secretary subscription is created and no other doctor membership is changed by this invitation.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-009.

requirements.title: Granular delegation enforced in the backend
requirements.summary: Implement explicit capabilities for patient administration, scheduling, intake, documents and settings scoped to doctor/location. Presentation reflects authorization but is not its boundary. Acceptance: Doctor can grant only selected capabilities or all approved delegable administrative capabilities. Every command/query/attachment access path enforces matching backend grants. No capability grants access to another doctor; no implicit employee-to-owner escalation. Clinical signing and prescribing authority are not implemented in M1; the later physician-only boundary remains a safety decision, not a secretary role shortcut.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-010.

requirements.title: Patient directory and safe administrative CRUD
requirements.summary: Provide the authorized doctor/secretary patient-administration web flow: create, search, paginate, edit and archive the doctor-practice patient record. Acceptance: Use server-side scoped search/pagination and explicit empty/error/denied states. A shared phone number or matching name never automatically merges people or grants a patient app account. Create/update is validated and retry-safe; concurrent updates cannot silently overwrite identity data. Archive preserves referenced records; no bulk hard-delete or cross-doctor patient discovery.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-011.

requirements.title: Patient profile, administrative timeline and private documents
requirements.summary: Deliver a usable patient profile with demographics, administrative activity and authorized document upload/view. This is not yet a signed clinical record or patient-facing portal. Acceptance: Show explicit doctor/location provenance and distinguish entered data from verified data. Attachments have private storage, type/size validation and scoped access; no public object URL. Record uploader, timestamps and replacement/archive history; downloading requires current access. No clinical findings, prescription efficacy, identity verification or result interpretation is invented.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-012.

requirements.title: Working hours, availability and appointment rules
requirements.summary: Configure doctor/location working hours, exceptions, slot duration and conflict detection for a browser-based schedule. Acceptance: The same doctor cannot silently book overlapping commitments across different locations. Respect explicit timezone, exceptions and location permissions. Availability and booking share one authoritative conflict rule. Override policy, if any, is explicit and auditable rather than a client bypass.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-013.

requirements.title: Appointments, check-in and live waiting queue
requirements.summary: Deliver booking/rescheduling/cancellation/check-in and an operational queue without prescribing or billing scope. Acceptance: Use explicit appointment states and allowed transitions; no illegal double-check-in. Rescheduling and cancellation preserve history and are retry-safe. Queue updates remain scoped, recover after reconnect and do not leak other doctors. Notifications beyond in-app status updates remain gated; no unapproved SMS/WhatsApp service is enabled.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-014.

requirements.title: Doctor and secretary operational web dashboards
requirements.summary: Provide each authorized actor with a real-data Today view, appointments, waiting queue and relevant administrative actions rather than a generic placeholder dashboard. Acceptance: Metrics and lists use authoritative scoped queries and agreed time windows, not only loaded page rows. Doctor sees all authorized locations; secretary sees only granted capabilities and locations. Every displayed item links to its permitted source record. No unsupported financial/clinical metric or fabricated sample result is shown outside clearly labeled demo fixtures.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-015.

requirements.title: Profile, security and communication-preference settings
requirements.summary: Provide product-scoped account/profile settings and nonclinical communication preferences, with safe session and ownership boundaries. Acceptance: Separate personal account profile, doctor practice profile and membership permissions. Sensitive settings require the configured reauthentication/authorization policy. Preferences are explicit and scoped; do not enroll people in marketing or enable paid channels. Unsupported subscription/export controls are absent or truthfully unavailable, not fake successful buttons.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-016.

requirements.title: Audit visibility and administrative data-preservation controls
requirements.summary: Expose a permission-scoped audit view and safe archival/correction behavior for M1 administrative records, while preparing the explicit real-data governance gate. Acceptance: Audit covers administrative writes, invitations/grants and document access according to approved policy. Client users cannot modify audit events or silently erase linked history. No clinical bulk export, erasure or retention period is guessed; unresolved policies remain disabled and documented. Audit view is scoped, searchable and excludes credentials or unnecessary sensitive payloads.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-017.

requirements.title: Responsive web, accessibility and failure-recovery acceptance
requirements.summary: Close measurable cross-journey usability gaps in the working website/portal, rather than deferring foundational UX until the end. Acceptance: All M1 critical journeys work on narrow mobile browser and desktop in both approved locales/themes. Keyboard/focus/labels, validation, overlays and reduced-motion settings are verified. Slow/offline/reconnect and repeated actions show honest unsaved state; M1 does not promise offline clinical writes. Shared fixes remain centralized with affected consumer regression coverage.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-018.

requirements.title: Public metadata, support paths and website preview readiness
requirements.summary: Complete public-site metadata and support/navigation behavior while keeping private routes unindexed and future capabilities clearly separated from released functionality. Acceptance: Public titles/descriptions, canonical URL configuration and locale metadata are correct after domain approval. Private/authenticated pages are not exposed through generated sitemaps, public caches or share metadata. Use only approved brand assets/copy and actual support destinations; no fabricated app-store links or pricing. Prepare release fragments/checks and a preview handoff; do not merge, deploy, activate release registration or publish a released version.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-019.

requirements.title: Milestone 1 end-to-end verification and owner demo handoff
requirements.summary: Independently verify the full synthetic website/doctor/secretary vertical slice and prepare an evidence-backed milestone acceptance packet. This is not clinical or commercial launch approval. Acceptance: Doctor alone can onboard, add two clinics, create a patient, book/check in and review their queue/profile. All required unit, local data-authorization, browser, shared-consumer, boundary, lint/typecheck/build checks have exact evidence. Report implemented versus verified versus published/integrated/deployed separately; real patients, payment, prescribing and mobile availability remain gated.
requirements.provenance: Proposed decomposition of this intake; task DOS-M1-020.
